---
title: "graph"
format: html
---

```{r}
ggplot(menSkating1, aes(x = SP, y = FS, color = Year, shape = Year, fill = Year)) +
  geom_point(size = 5) +
  geom_smooth(method = lm, se = FALSE, size = 2) +
  scale_shape_manual(name = "Year",
    values = c("2010" = 21, "2014" = 22, "2018" = 23, "2022" = 24)) +
  labs(title = "Men's Figure Skating SP vs FS 2010 – 2022",
    x = "Short Program Score",
    y = "Free Skate Score", 
    color = "Year",
    shape = "Year") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 23, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 20),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 16))

```
